events.verdict: Plumlee (PHX) initiates illegal contact with Morant's (MEM) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Bane (MEM) and Durant (PHX) engage on the perimeter and Durant loses his balance when he attempts to disengage.
Beal (PHX) legally contests Morant's (MEM) jump shot attempt.
Plumlee (PHX) legally contests and cleanly blocks Morant's (MEM) driving shot attempt.
Bane (MEM) briefly rests his hands on Durant's (PHX) body as he starts his drive in transition and the contact is marginal.
Bol (PHX) jumps to contest Clarke's (MEM) shot attempt in the lane and the contact as the two players come together is incidental.
Although Clarke (MEM) jumps vertically, he lowers his arms across Beal's (PHX) arm and initiates illegal contact that affects the driving shot attempt.
Plumlee (PHX) rests a forearm against Clarke's (MEM) body and the contact with Clarke's arm after the release is incidental.
Morant (MEM) commits a take foul on Bol (PHX).
Durant (PHX) avoids making any illegal contact with Morant (MEM) as Morant drifts toward Durant during the jump shot attempt.
Durant (PHX) is not established in Wells' (MEM) path when he firms up in a screening position, but the contact is marginal.
Kennard (MEM) commits a take foul on Allen (PHX).
Beal (PHX) moves alongside Morant (MEM) as he moves into his shooting motion and the contact is marginal.
Durant (PHX) and Bane (MEM) briefly engage and disengage during the throw-in.
Bane (MEM) legally contests Durant's (PHX) jump shot attempt.
Beal (PHX) maintains a legal guarding position and makes clean contact with the ball during Morant's (MEM) drive.
Beal (PHX) legally contests Morant's (MEM) jump shot attempt.
Durant (PHX) briefly places his arm against Aldama (MEM) and releases from contact.
Bol (PHX) deflects the pass out of bounds.
Clarke (MEM) firms up on his right foot in Allen's (PHX) path and absorbs the contact during the pick.
Plumlee (PHX) makes contact with Morant's (MEM) wrist prior to the release, which affects his jump shot attempt.
Allen (PHX) extends his arms into Wells (MEM), dislodging him from his position.
Allen (PHX) commits a take foul on Clarke (MEM). A non-shooting foul is correctly called, as the foul occurs prior to Clarke's shooting motion.
Beal's (PHX) momentum carries him away from Morant (MEM) and marginal foot contact occurs that does not affect Morant's SQBR.
Dunn (PHX) legally contests Wells' (MEM) dunk attempt.
Clarke (MEM) commits a take foul on Durant (PHX). A non-shooting foul is correctly assessed as the foul occurs prior to Durant's upward shooting motion.
Clarke (MEM) contests Durant's (PHX) jump shot and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.

There is no clear and conclusive video evidence that confirms who touches the ball last before it goes out of bounds. The on-court officials have doubt; therefore, there is a jump ball at midcourt when play resumes.
Morant (MEM) legally contests Durant's (PHX) jump shot attempt.
